nom: Beekman 1802 Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel & Makeup Remover

avis.texte: I was happy to find a product that boasted it could remove heavy makeup in one step. However, I did not find this to be true. Plus, I do not wear heavy makeup. A little powder and liquid blush. After using a large amount of the cleanser, much of the makeup remained. The product works better for my weekend routine of using tinted sunscreen only. Definitely not to be used as advertised for heavy makeup.
This cleanser is so gentle. I have extremely sensitive skin and this does not break me out.

I normally love this brand, but this was a huge miss for me. Leaves an oily film & A LOT of makeup residue, even after two washes. Can't even effectively remove tint moisturizer. Maybe it's better for pp that don't wear makeup at all or use it as a pre-wash.

This cleanser is one of the best ever to hit the market. The gel cleanser lathers generously and works to remove makeup, dirt, oil, and impurities. Rinses well. Skin doesn't feel stripped of natural oils but is rather soft and hydrates.

First off…you only need a drop of this product to get a milky, foamy, and gentle cleanse. I have rosacea and have not had any adverse reaction to it ( which is a huge plus). I ALWAYS double cleanse with micellar water first but if there is any makeup remaining, this will remove it. Will buy again.
I absolutely LOVE this 2 in 1 cleanser. As a makeup girly it really removes all my makeup while still really being gentle.

It feels real nice on the skin, but my nose is always dry and peeling and I don't feel like it removes makeup as well as an advertised. I also didn't realize I was buying a sample size for the amount of money that I paid
I can't say I notice much difference in my skin but this FEELS so nice! I'd repurchase for the experience alone.

This works as 2-in-1 cleanser and makeup remover. Product is super thick, lathers very well, kept skin hydrated & worked great on my combo-dry skin. This is not a heavy duty face cleanser so may need to wash 2x to fully remove makeup.

Within 2 days of using only in the evenings, it dried my skin out. I live in Colorado so already dry here, but this was bad. I thought the gel to 'milk' description would have a smooth/milky feel like I've hd with others. Not the case and I do not recommend.

avis.titre: enjoy using it but not my favorite
avis.texte: This cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean.. Seems gentle but effective. Until I'm using it to remove makeup. It's not as effective as some other cleansers I have and thus I wonder how well it's actually working on non-makeup skim for oil/sweat/stuff if it's not fully removing visible makeup
I love the Brekman 1802 products and this gel cleanser is one of my favorites!! Love the foaming cleanse and it is super gentle.
I have very sensitive skin and this cleanser removes even eye makeup with little effort while not causing any itchiness or dryness.

absolutely love this cleanser. when i first started using it i couldn't place the smell and then realized it smells like buttered popcorn jelly bellies. not a bad smell just not what i was expecting. much better than floral/perfumey.

This is one cleanser that I have purchased over and over again. I wear a full face of make up every day, even on my days off! I love eye makeup! I wear full coverage foundation… And this product removes everything off my face! Also, it does not leave my skin dry After using it… I truly love this facial cleanser, and yes! It does remove all make up. I would highly recommend.
It's super easy to use and helps removes makeup up so good, I would definitely purchase in the future!
Great cleanser, removes makeup including the eye makeup and works well with the sensitive skin.

this product SAVED my skin. My skin barrier was destroyed with 'sensitive skin friendly' products over the last few years and nothing fixed it until this. Using it every night for only 2 weeks it's already almost completed healed. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

avis.titre: I would absolutely buy this product again
avis.texte: I usually purchase cream cleansers… However, I've been wanting to try this brand and I thought I would go ahead and try this particular cleanser… I felt the cleanser left my skin still feeling hydrated, it removed all of my facial makeup along with my eye makeup! My face did not feel dehydrated or tight at all… Which I think is a nice sign for a gel type cleanser… I would go ahead and try it …and I have mature skin.
I love how this works I been using this in the morning and at night the only thing I don't like it is the smell the should work on that. When you put it you can smell it just for a seconds
I love this wash. My face feels so clean. Ive used Mary kay cosmetics for 20 yrs. Switched to beekman. I do alot of research and this brand is very healthy for skin. Thank u beekman
Wow I've never used such an effective cleanser. I washed my face after using a mascara that is stubborn to remove and it washed right off!!! Amazing!
Love this for when I need to remove my makeup in the shower. No blurred vision. Clean feel.

Was excited to use this as a first step / pre cleanse since it says will remove makeup but i found it wasnt to effective for me, id either have to go in again with it before my actual cleasner or use my cleanser twice. Love the brand in general though just not a fan of this product :(

avis.titre: I love this product, it's a 10 out of 10.
avis.texte: My skin is dry and sensitive, and this cleanser is amazing — it cleans so well but still leaves my skin hydrated and with an incredible glow.

I was so excited to try this, because it's meant to be a one-step cleanser. Unfortunately I tried to use it to remove tinted mineral sunscreen and it wasn't effective - I wiped my face with a tissue after cleansing and there was a ton of sunscreen left. Will have to return it, because it's totally useless for my routine.
I went in looking for the milk face wash in this brand which was discontinued. This is very harsh leaving my face very dry. Returning
It does a amazing job at cleansing my face without any extra scrub

I've been using this cleanser for about 2 mos and primarily for eye makeup removal and then allover as my first step in double cleansing-it works well, doesn't break me out or strip my skin. I recommend and will be repurchasing
This is a great cleansing gel as most Breekman products are. It leaves your face clean without stripping your skin, I use it twice a day and my skin is supple and bouncy.
I used this micellar milk froth daily, and it was just okay. It worked fine as a makeup remover, but it did not remove waterproof makeup well. If you're wearing lighter makeup, this will work.

I tried the cleanser without using a make up wipe. I still had some make up remaining. Next night, I used a make up wipe first and then the Micellar Milk Froth. It left my face clean and feeling great. No dryness. If you use a strong setting spray, I highly suggest using a makeup wipe first.

This has quickly become my new favorite makeup remover. It really removes all makeup with the first wash and leaves your face feeling fresher. You only have to use a small amount of product for results, so each tube has a great value.

So I have been using the Beekman Micellar Milk Froth for about 3 weeks now and I am very impressed ! This is truly a great product . The Milk Froth is a 2-in-1 Cleansing Gel & Makeup Remover for sensitive skin, which I found to be true because it did not dry out my skin. It also contains great ingredients such as goat milk saponins which removes 100% of impurities without irritation and also golden sea moss which replenishes essential minerals with every wash. Overall a great product ! I would recommend this to my family and friends !

The Beekman 1802 Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel & Makeup Remover feels like pure luxury on my skin. From the very first use, I could tell it was a high-quality product. It's gentle yet incredibly effective as a face wash and makeup remover, leaving my skin feeling clean, refreshed, and nourished without any harshness. What really impressed me is how well it scored on ingredient-rating apps. I try to avoid harmful ingredients whenever possible, and this cleanser delivers peace of mind with a safe, skin-friendly formula with an added bonus of 92 minerals to replenish and support my skin's health. This is a product I'd absolutely recommend if you want something that's effective, gentle, and prioritizes clean, beneficial ingredients. It's worth every penny for the results and peace of mind!
You can definitely smell the milk in it, but it does leave your skin really nice and soft afterwards and it also cleans it very well.
It is gentle and not drying on my skin. It also removes makeup well!

This cleanser is very gentle and does not strip your skin. I used it to wash off my eye makeup and it didn't sting at all. I enjoy how gentle this feels and look forward to using it more in the future.
Hi, I absolutely love this product and how it made my skin feel it is amazing and I would definitely recommend to a friend.

So I tried Micellar Milk Froth and it works amazing. It cleans my facial after I wear makeup and need a simple cleaae ok my face this is my go to brand. Makes my skin clean and silky. My kid be radiant and glowing as well.

I am in love with this Micellar cleanser!! I received the Beekman 1802 Micellar Milk Froth in exchange for an honest review and when I tell you I am hooked, I mean it!! It's a gel, which I am fond of & it lathers nicely. It completely removes my makeup without making my skin feel stripped. I have sensitive skin and this cleanser is super gentle yet effective. I'll be purchasing this in the future!!

avis.titre: One of the best cleansers I've used
avis.texte: Have used micellar water and my skin did not respond well. This cleanser was a game changer. I don't know if it's the goat milk or just a great formulation, but I've used this morning and evening for about 10 days. I've used it to take off makeup, which worked pretty well. This did not dry out my skin even after a double cleanse with this. My barrier around my mouth and my chin has been sensitive for a couple years. This has been the only effective cleanser that didn't upset my skin barrier. LOVE IT!

avis.titre: Gentle to the skin with compromised skin barrier
avis.texte: As someone living in Chicago, the brutal cold and constant exposure to road salt can really take a toll on my skin. This winter, my skin barrier became severely compromised, leaving me with irritated, dry patches, redness, and a heightened sensitivity to most products. But, after trying Beekman 1802's Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel & Makeup Remover, I've finally found a product that gently addresses my skin's needs without causing further distress. The texture is smooth, almost like a soft milk, and it froths just the right amount to clean without feeling stripping. I've always been hesitant with cleansers, especially after my skin barrier damage, because many are too harsh or leave my face feeling tight and dry. This cleansing gel, however, is remarkably soothing. It effectively removes makeup and daily grime without causing any irritation. If you have extremely sensitive skin like mine, or if your skin has been compromised by harsh weather and environmental factors, I highly recommend giving Beekman 1802's Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel & Makeup Remover a try. It's a gentle, effective, and skin-loving option that won't disrupt your delicate skin barrier.

I appreciate that this product is made with clean ingredients and is protective of delicate facial skin. I also like that a little goes a long way. However, it doesn't do a great job at removing eye makeup and I'm not a fan of the scent. I tend to like scented products (which this is not) and this one has a chemical plastic smell.

Beekman continues to innovate new ways to reward your skin with clinically kind treatments. The micellar formula in this cleanser allows for thorough makeup removing without having to double cleanse and the combo of 92 minerals leaves your face feeling refreshed and smooth straight out of step 1. My favorite part is the natural essence of the golden sea moss that leaves you feeling like you are in the middle of your own spa day without running the risk of breakouts or irritation.

So I used this product for 3 weeks and here are my thoughts. I like the consistency and I believe it gives a good clean without fully stripping my face. Even with a face full of makeup, it got the job done. My biggest gripe with this product is the smell. The smell is horrible, almost like a glue type of smell. Even though it cleanses really well the smell, for me, is unbearable. The packaging was also really nice.

Got a sample of this product from a vendor and I am definitely going to buy a full size tomorrow! This product melted my makeup away so easily took literally almost no effort at all. Even when I used my regular cleanser after, there was barely any trace of makeup on my 4x4! Normally when I would use just regular micellar water to remove makeup or even a "precleanse" oil product, I would still be wiping off a lot of makeup with my second cleanse. This gets 95% of my makeup off by itself!Felt great on my skin as well. 10/10
I used it to remove make up I love how gentle it is how it well it worked and how soft my skin felt and smooth and cleared my face was after using it a couple times

My skin is very sensitive for cleansers, most of them usually strip down my face leaving it dry and tight. With this Micellar Milk Froth it is not the case. A great makeup remover, sometimes i feel lazy to use makeup removing balms, and this cleanser removes mascara and eyeliner surprisingly well. The smell can be a little unpleasant, mostly because the product is fragrance free, hence probably has the smell of ingredients, but it's ok. I would prefer this than added artificial fragrances.

I made the switch to all natural skincare products during 2020 and haven't deviated from my cleansing bar since then. I just haven't found a great cleansing product with clean ingredients that was able to do the job. I loved this Micellar Milk Froth from the moment I opened it. It didn't have a strong scent and was not tacky. I was able to get a good cleanse with a bare face, minimal makeup and even with a full makeup and long- lasting lipstick. I am thoroughly impressed! After cleaning, I could even feel my pores tighten. This was a feeling that I missed from my natural soap bars. Also, it didn't break me out! Which is hard to manage after so many years of using the same skincare products. I had my teenaged son who suffers from mild acne use in his skincare regimen as well. I was so excited, I even shared with my daughter in law because it was just THAT good! I'll be continuing with this product in my skincare regimen from now on.

The formula of the product is gentle on the skin but great at removing a full face glam look. It foams up nicely with a good lather. Found it took off my waterproof mascara easily. I did do a double cleanse with the face wash to make sure my face was clean. The wash does not leave a residue on the skin and did not cause my sensitive skin any irritation or breakouts.

I just discovered this when in search of a cleanser that would remove my makeup while not stripping my skin or tearing down my skin's barrier. Beekmans 1802 has created an amazing cleansing gel that foams up and leaves skin feeling smooth and soft. It contains micellar water golden sea moss and goat milk. It has a generous size, and a little goes a long way and does the job no need to wonder if the makeup was really gone it does have a plant like smell not overwhelming just present.
I used the product to remove my make up. It froths up nicely and has a rich texture. The smell is not overpowering. I did still have to double cleanse but it was very effective

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. This cleanser worked well with removing my makeup and mascara. It lathered up well and I did not need a lot to get the makeup removed. Overall, I will purchase in the future as it was not harsh or drying on my skin and removed all of the makeup.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product
avis.texte: Leaves skin feeling great, not greasy residues . Definitely recommend this to anyone.

If you have sensitive skin and want a no-fuss way to remove makeup and cleanse, the Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel is a game changer. This 2-in-1 formula effortlessly takes off makeup (even long-wear!) while leaving your skin soft and hydrated, without that tight, dry feeling. What I love most is how gentle it is. The combination of goat milk saponins and micelles cleanses without irritation, and the golden sea moss helps replenish your skin with minerals. It's non-drying, non-irritating, and honestly feels like a treat for your skin. No need for a separate makeup remover or face wash, this one does it all in one step. Plus, it's suitable for all skin types, so it's a win for everyone!

I've been using this cleanser for the last few weeks and it does an excellent job at deeply cleansing pores of makeup and oil without drying the skin. It even takes mascara off without leaving a tone behind that requires additional cleansing which is nice on a tired night.

It is an excellent product, it leaves your face with an excellent texture, it removes the oil and does not leave your skin dry, I recommend it Reduces open pores, your skin is fresh and soft, it does not irritate. I have sensitive skin and I love this product

This is a great brand and I was excited to try this new product! The cleanser was great and took my makeup off without stripping my face. I have dry skin in the winter and this cleanser is perfect for me!
This cleanser was effective at removing makeup and other dirt and oil from my face. However, I found it average and slightly drying. I wouldn't pay a premium for this.
My new favorite for cleaning off makeup at the end of the day! My face feels clean without being dried out. Love!

I've tried this product several times now. Packaging is nice, not much of a scent and I appreciate that it doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped. In my experience however, it isn't good at removing makeup, especially mascara. I'd only continue to use this on no makeup days.

I used it a few times and so far I like it. It's really gentle and good for dry skin, and other skin types too I'm sure. It took my makeup off without an issue, however I haven't worn mascara for a while, so I don't know how it is at taking that off. Anyway, if you're looking for a gentle cleanser that doesn't strip your skin and has good ingredients you should try it out. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I recently tried this product and love the packaging. It's frosted and goes well with the yellow. Onto the product itself, I believe it cleanses fairly well. It makes my skin feel much cleaner if I'm not wearing make up. As a makeup remover, I do think it needs to be a little stronger. It doesn't get rid of everything.

avis.titre: Review of Beekman 1802 Micellar Milk Froth Cleanser
avis.texte: As a 32-year-old with a busy schedule, I need a skincare routine that's effective and low-effort. The Beekman 1802 Micellar Milk Froth Cleanser fits perfectly. It's gentle yet removes makeup and dirt easily, leaving my skin soft and hydrated without feeling tight or dry. I love the light, clean scent and the creamy foam—it feels like a little luxury in my routine. The pump bottle is convenient, and a little goes a long way, making it worth the price. If you want a gentle, hydrating cleanser, this one's a winner!

I loveeee this product. This product is so light yet makes my face feel so clean. It isn't harsh or stripping. It feels so luxurious. I will definitely be adding this to my daily skincare routine. I'm absolutely obsessed.

avis.titre: I love how it leaves my skin
avis.texte: I use it at the end of the day to help remove the rest of my make up. Love how soft and fresh it left my skin. It has help especially on this winter days. Definitely getting it again!
I used this product to take off my makeup and wash my face at night. It has a smooth gel texture that feels calming on the face. My face felt clean and soft after use. I would recommend this product.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I used this product to wash my face. The cleansing gel has a pleasant lemon fragrance. The texture sticky but once you apply on your face your skin feels fresh and clean it has a cool feeling. After you wash your face your skin feel sticky but within a minute it feels soft.

I recently had the chance to try Micellar Milk Froth thanks to a free sample from BzzAgent, and I'm impressed with how well it works. Compared to other makeup removers I've tried, this one is gentler on the skin while still being highly effective—it removes makeup, including waterproof mascara, without leaving my skin feeling dry or stripped. The creamy, frothy texture is soothing and it combines the benefits of micellar water with the hydration of milk. This product is a great multitasker, acting as both a cleanser and makeup remover, and I love how it leaves my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized. I would definitely buy it again, as it simplifies my routine and works wonderfully for my sensitive skin. I've already recommended it to friends and family.

The Micellar Milk Froth is excellent to clean your face and remove dirt and make up. It makes a good amount of foam with just a little product. It leaves your fave feeling very clean and soft. Furthermore, it has golden sea moss and goat milk, which is good for your skin, and doesn't have any fragrance.

I liked the fact that this didn't have much fragrance it was very gentle on my sensitive combination skin. It did remove the oils from my face and my skin felt squeaky clean. It didn't remove mascara though so don't expect it to remove stubborn mascara. I would purchase this product and I would also recommend this product to someone looking for a mild cleanser.

I have oily acne prone skin so I am very picky about what products I use on my face. I have large pores so I appreciate a good cleanser for removing everyday dirt and makeup as well. Most cleansers usually strip my face leaving it dry but this one cleaned my face in one round leaving it feeling refreshing and not dry. The biggest benefit is that it got rid of all my makeup while being gentle at the same time. A little goes a long way too, therefore it'll last a long time. This has earned a place on my vanity. I recommend this for all skin types, because it really is a gentle giant!

This cleanser is amazing! It feels amazing on the skin and is not drying! Doesn't have a strong perfume smell which is great. I have super sensitive skin but I skipped the patch test. After using the product my face did not break out, my skin felt super soft, and left a clean feeling. 10/10, would definitely buy over and over!

I would like to start off by stating that I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This facial cleanser is perfect for my dry skin. It leaves my skin hydrated and removes all makeup.

From the first use, I was impressed by its rich, creamy texture that gently cleanses without stripping my skin. It effortlessly removes makeup and daily impurities, leaving my face feeling fresh, soft, and hydrated. I have sensitive skin, and this cleanser is incredibly soothing, with no irritation or tightness afterward. The subtle, clean scent is a pleasant bonus, making each use feel like a little self-care ritual. It's a perfect balance of effective cleansing and nourishing care

avis.titre: Soft, hydrated skin without the tightness
avis.texte: I received this Micellar Milk Froth for free to try it out for a few days. I have sensitive, oily, and rosacea-prone skin, so I usually stick to dermatologist-prescribed products. However, I was pleasantly surprised with this product because it was so gentle on my skin. It never caused any adverse reactions and left my skin feeling clean, soft, and moisturized without that tight, dry feeling my usual dermatologist-recommended cleanser tends to leave. This is definitely a product I would purchase and recommend for all skin types, even for picky skin like mine.

avis.titre: I would buy it again and again
avis.texte: I wear makeup a lot because of the nature of my job. I have tried many makeup removers but they are very uncomfortable. My face is sensitive so I choose products very carefully. I tried Milk Froth, a 2-in-1 Cleansing & Makeup Remover Gel for Sensitive Skin, which has been proven to double cleanse in one easy step—without drying or stripping the skin. The signature blend of goat milk saponin and millions of powerful micelles removes 100% of impurities without irritation, while golden sea moss replenishes essential minerals with each wash. I am very satisfied with this product and will recommend it to my friends.

I have been using the Miceller Milk Froth for about 2 weeks now and I can truly say I enjoy it. I use a little over a pea sized amount and massage it into my wet skin. One of my unexpected favorite things about this cleanser is that it froths/foams up. Its unexpected because I have recently tried a number of cleansers that don't foam and I wasn't expecting to realize I missed the foaming. After washing it off, I notice my skin is clean but not stripped which some cleansers can do. Overall, I really enjoy this product and would purchase for myself and recommend to others as well!

This is a perfect first step cleanser that doesn't leave the skin feeling oily or stripped. I don't wear a lot of eye makeup but the mascara and cream shadow that are part of my daily routine were able to come off easily. I usually follow it with an additional cleaner if I have been wearing foundation but on my real no make up days this cleaner is enough.

I got this complimentary from Beekman 1802. This micellar milk froth cleanser froths up and lathers well. A little goes a long way. Only a dime size amount is needed. My face feels refreshed and clean when using it to wash my face in the morning. It does not have a strong smell.

avis.titre: I will purchase this product again.
avis.texte: I use this product in the evening, to wash away the days makeup. I found this product to be very effective at removing all of my make up, with out that dry feeling some other products leave and it passed the white towel test. No make up on my towel after drying my face!!! I highly recommend and will purchase again and again.

avis.titre: Smell amazing and easy to use
avis.texte: I use it to clean off my face after a long day of wearing make up and being outside. It works great, making skin feel clean and soft. I can go straight to bed after this if i feel exhausted without worrying.

Beekman Micellar Milk Froth is an all-in-one cleanser that is both gentle and highly effective. When applied to damp skin, the gel transforms into a rich lather, providing a soft and gentle cleansing experience. It efficiently removes sunscreen and makeup without causing any tightness in the skin. After patting the skin dry, it appears radiant and clean. This cleanser is highly recommended for all skin types.

I've been trying this product for a week. Although the cleanser works just fine, I feel like it doesn't lather really well in my opinion. I also wish it has exfoliating scrubs for deep cleanse. It's still a good face wash with all the beneficial minerals that you can try but just not for me.

avis.titre: Will work for most! Removed toughest waterproof eyeliners
avis.texte: But didn't remove the toughest lipstick. I'm a fitness instructor I'm constantly sweating. For reference, the liquid liners that stick through sweat and water and my oily creased lids are MAC liquidlast & KikoMilano Definition waterproof liner, and the lipstick is Maybelline Superstay Matte Ink. So this stuff is meant to stay! So for that I'll use an oil based makeup remover. If you use regular MAC lipsticks it'll probably remove those. The cleanser is gentle so my face was not overdried. I've tried this brand of shampoo & conditioner at Lifetime and that's amazing! So I wasn't surprised that this worked well, perhaps even better than I expected because it's hard to be simultaneously gentle and remove makeup. Got so used to using it daily that almost forgot to review it. Definitely recommend! I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion.

This is an amazing product. Did not dry my skin out after using and did not cause any irritation. That's a Win/Win in my book. It absorbed beautifully. I liked it so much, I made it a stocking stuffer gift for my bestie! I received this product for free in exchange for giving my honest review.
My skin is so much better, my face is getting clearer everyday!
I received this as part of a promotion. I use morning and evening. Removed makeup and eye makeup without stinging eyes. Leaves skin clean but not dry.

avis.titre: Best product I didn't know I NEEDED!
avis.texte: I was sent this Beekman 1802 Micellar Milk Froth makeup remover free for my honest review and I have never used a better makeup remover in my life! I've never been particular about makeup remover, except not using wipes. I use balms or micellar water and cloths; but THIS is a game changer! I didn't have high expectations because it's just a makeup remover; but now I will never use anything else. I wear makeup daily and this has been amazing. It doesn't annoy me to wash my face because it's a 2-in-1; so no matter how tired I am, I use this and it removes every single piece of makeup and actually cleanses my face at the same time. It's not drying, removes makeup and impurities and dirt in one wash. This even removes difficult eye makeup with ease and comfort. When they say cleansing gel, it's just that - a foaming gel that feels good on skin while washing and really clears out pores. It leaves my skin soft, hydrated, and pristine. I can't recommend this enough! It's a great value for the price point, size, and effectiveness!

The name is perfect for this face wash. The lather is milky and luxurious feeling, you can tell there's moisturizers in it. It doesn't get crazy foamy/bubbly like the stronger more harsh face washes but has enough lather. It doesn't strip your face which exactly what I'm looking for. I'm in my mid 30s now and after having kids, my face is so dry when I used to be oily. It's a hard transition going from oily to dry and this face wash helps. There's also no fragrance!

avis.titre: Removes makes without stripping the skin
avis.texte: It is perfect for my prone-to-drying and breakouts skin. The cleanser is an odorless clear gel that doesn't foam much, but is great at removing all of my makeup, including my near-waterproof mascara. The cleanser uses foaming agents derives from goat milk, which I see why my skin loves so much. The cleanser doesn't strip my natural oils and does a good job at cleansing my skin. I noticed that I don't need to use as much moisturizer even in dry winter months.

Ever since getting this product I can't seem to put it down. It's one of the few products that gets off all of your makeup with just one use. Before I would have to use a product multiple times to get my make up off and that's not the case for this amazing cleanser. It leaves my face looking so glowy and feeling so smooth! I would recommend this product to everyone who wants a GREAT cleanser that doesn't rub your skin dry!

This is a great face wash. I normally use Cerave which is also very good. This cleans my face without stripping it dry. It removes my make up well and gently. I also really like that it foams and is not just a gel. I highly recommend it. I received this as a free sample.

I use this product morning and night for cleansing. At night, it is effective at removing my makeup without over drying my skin. I don't feel moisturized after using it, but it doesn't leave me dry either. There is no residue leftover and I can use it twice daily. I like the gel-like texture and that it give a soft foam when lathered. Although I received the product in exchange for my honest review, I would purchase the cleanser again.

Beekman 1802 Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel & Makeup Remover is a standout product in the crowded market of facial cleansers. Its innovative blend of micellar technology and moisturizing ingredients makes it a versatile option for anyone looking to simplify their cleansing routine without sacrificing quality.

This is a 2 in-1 cleanser that claims to remove everything in a single step. While this is a water based cleanser, I find that the micelles and surfactant system helps take off concealer, sunscreen, oil and grime throughout the day without leaving my skin stripped. I haven't tried this with a full face on as I imagine a separate makeup remover or oil cleanser would be better in ensuring everything is removed properly.
Love this cleanser. It removes makeup effortlessly and leave my skin feeling refreshed and clean

I received Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel & Makeup Remover as complimentary from Beekman 1802. This cleanser is gentle and non-drying, which is perfect for my dry skin. It left my skin feeling soft and hydrated rather than tight or stripped, which I really appreciated. I also loved the light, fresh scent. As a makeup remover, though, it didn't seem completely effective. It worked well for removing light makeup, but it struggled with waterproof makeup products. I found myself sometimes needing to use a separate makeup remover to completely clean them.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy this product in the future
avis.texte: This face cleanser is amazing! It get's super frothy but doesn't have a scent. My skin feels so clean after using it. I've been trying it for about a week now every night and my skin hasn't been irritated or dry. I will 100% be purchasing another once I am done with this bottle!

I use the Micellar milk froth cleanser twice a day on my face. I love the scent of the cleanser. It leaves my skin soft and healthy. The ingredients used are of superior quality like goat milk, golden sea moss and micellar water.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: After you wash your face using this cleanser, it leaves your skin feeling so hydrated and soft! I love it! It lathers and hydrates the skin! Definitely a must have in the routine! I tried doing the Micellar water challenge to see if I have any makeup residue left but NO there was none! It did a great job in removing all the dirt and leftover makeup and left my skin feeling extremely clean and soft.
Easily removes dirt, makeup and sweat. Leaved skin clean yet hydrated. Perfect for makeup cleanup or for use as part of a dual cleanse. Highly recommended!

Beekman 1802 Micellar Milk Froth Cleansing Gel and makeup remover feels gentle on my skin. It completely removes makeup, excess oil and impurities from my skin without stripping or drying it out. It contains micellar water, golden sea moss and goat milk. A dimension sized amount is all I need to thoroughly cleanse my face.
My skin feels so clean after using this face wash. My skin does not feel stripped or tight. Takes my makeup off wonderfully.
Exceeded my expectations. I loved it!! Successfully removed my make up and left my skin suft soft and clean!! Highly recommended! I ussed 1-2 pea size amount and just enough

Beekman 1802 MICELLAR MILK FROTH cleansing gel & makeup remover is a goat milk based facial cleanser. It does not strip the skin of essential moisture and removes all traces of makeup and impurities. Beekman never disappoints, that's for sure. Great cleanser!
Love how my skin feels after using this product. My daughter also raves about this products. My skin feels refreshed and so clean. Highly recommend

I received this product for free in exchange for writing an honest review. I was pleasantly surprised with this product! This product is unique since it really is like micellar water (makeup remover) and face wash in one. It cleans super well, while being gentle on the skin. Does not dry out the skin at all. I would repurchase this product 100%. I would recommend this product to friends and family. My only complaint would be that I wish the product size was a little bigger, but I do double wash my face at the end of each day. Overall would recommend trying out this product.
What I liked was the practicality of being able to remove all the makeup and also being a cleanser. Not needing cotton pads to use it is really convenient. It leaves the skin without dryness.

avis.titre: Leaves face feeling fresh and clean
avis.texte: I loved Beekman Micellar Froth cleansing gel and makeup remover. It left my skin feeling soft and clean. I only had to use a dime size amount and it cleaned all my makeup right off. It has no smell to it and lathers up nicely.
I really enjoy how this product feels. I also like how it has little to no fragrance. My face feels great after using it!

Leaves my skin feeling hydrated and glowing. It didn't strip any moisture from my face as other cleansers would do. I didn't even have to apply moisturizer after using this Beekman Micellar Milk Froth. It even removed the makeup and dirt on my face. I absolutely loved this product .

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I love how hydrating my skin feels after using it. It makes my skin look and feel great. I like how it also has micellar because it acts like a makeup remover also. Waterproof mascara was a little hard to get but overall cleanses my skin very well.

Thanks to Beekman 1802 for the free product to review. I really like this makeup remover. It completely removes all my makeup quickly. It is not irritating and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed. It has a very subtle fragrance. I would recommend this product.

I had never tried anything like this Micellar Milk Froth . It is truly the greatest. It is a cleasing gel and makeup remover. I would buy this product 100%. I already recommended this to my friends and family . Gifted .
I wash my face with this each morning and night it's wonderful and hydrating
Cute design and color. Light fragrance and good foam. Gently massage and rinse with clean water then feel clean, shiny, smooth skin, grease is removed so it feels very comfortable.

avis.titre: Effective, gentle, and hydrating with minimal scent
avis.texte: The gel has a unique texture, blending the soothing qualities of milk with a frothy consistency that feels luxurious on the skin. It gently foams as you apply it, making it easy to spread across the face. It's suitable for daily use and works well even for sensitive skin types.
